distinct_mechanism_considered: Learn stochastic compact private-factor distributions conditional on one shared backbone instead of forcing separation of deterministic hidden states. Optional TRAIN-label context inference changes available evidence.
direct_collision: Rank-1 BNN already learns multimodal compact factor posteriors with deterministic shared W; MPNP already constructs graph-wide stochastic conditional label predictors from observed label context.
remaining_increment_unestablished: BE factor generation rather than latent concatenation, localized Gaussian-to-mixture inference and graph-correlated draws have ancestry or unresolved closest priors; no distinct failure mechanism established.
eligible_attributed_reference: Graph-coherent Rank-1 Bayesian graph model, subject to source/competence qualification; not a novel-method nomination.
conceptual_falsifier: Matched whole-task comparisons must recover competence-preserving coverage and pool quality beyond deterministic point factors; mean-versus-sampled evaluation attributes integration separately from stochastic training.
